author: Calciferous
body:
When I go to gravatar, (I made an account during the weekend) and when I switch it to gravatar on my profile, it shows the mystery man, even though I have a gravatar photo on my gravatar. I have the email for both my Avic.us account and my Gravatar account and it still won't work. I've tried on other sites, and they worked, so I was wondering if there was a way to link the two.

~Granule
